question: Who among the following Sadir dancer received the Padma Shri 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Muthukannammal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **R Muthukannamal**, 82, is ecstatic that she has won the Padma Shri in the arts category for Sathir.
 
• An ancient dance form that is a predecessor of the more popular** ****Bharathanatyam****,** in which she performed her** “arangetram”** (on stage debut) when she was only 7 years old.
 
• R Muthukannammal is a** seventh-generation veteran Sadir dancer** from the Indian State of Tamil Nadu.
 
• Devadasis (meaning servants of the divine) were associated with Sadir, **a traditional form of solo dance performed in temples and royal courts and to select audiences in private places**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/391c3074fae448c5e8179113a4befdfeadf099891e28338fe75dce460bbaf173.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jamyang Tsering Namgyal **is an Indian politician and Member of Parliament from **Ladakh**, India's largest parliamentary seat geographically. 
 
• **Sulochana Kadam**, known as **Sulochana Chavan **is an Indian singer, known for her** lavanis in Marathi.**
 
• Thavil Kongampattu A V Murugaiyan (born 1964) is a thavil player from the Puducherry Union Territory in India.
